Class HistoryController

java.lang.Object
com.controller.HistoryController
public class HistoryController extends Object
Manages transaction history and budget cycle data for the Masroofy application. Handles reading, writing, filtering, and modifying transactions stored in files, and coordinates with LimitEngine and AlertNotifier after changes.

    • editTransaction

      public boolean editTransaction(int id, double amount, int catId, String note)
      Edits an existing transaction's amount, category, and note. Recalculates the balance and daily limit after the update.
      Parameters:
      id - the ID of the transaction to edit
      amount - the new expense amount
      catId - the new category ID
      note - the new note
      Returns:
      true if the transaction was found and updated, false otherwise

    • deleteTransaction

      public void deleteTransaction(int id)

    • logExpense

      public void logExpense(double amount, int catId, String note, int cycleId)
      Logs a new expense transaction, saves it, and updates the cycle balance and daily limit. Triggers a budget alert if the spending threshold is reached.
      Parameters:
      amount - the expense amount
      catId - the category ID for this expense
      note - an optional note describing the expense
      cycleId - the ID of the current budget cycle
